svg.aria-label: One digest notification: One per sync instead of one per article, with Mark all read and Triage. Muted keywords: Articles mentioning them are marked read after each sync. Watched words: Words you care about stand out and come first. Duplicate stories: When a story is published again, only the first stays unread. Recently filtered: What was hidden and why, with Undo. Sort feeds and groups: By name, unread count or the order you added them.
